reasoning: Algebra-preserving fusion: PSNR per-view is bit-identical to iter-007 (59.518/62.260/59.995). Visual checks all pass with the same diff10 noise floor. However the kernel ms regressed 99.34 → 100.695 (+1.37%), which falls within the 2% break-even band but offers no improvement, while making the kernel less explicit (three live products in one acquire). Same class of negative result as iter-006: collapsing acquire cycles for FPU ops appears to remove overlap between pack and the next stage's setup, so theoretical 'saves 2 acquire cycles' becomes net-zero or slightly negative. REJECT with action=revert; lesson is that the 3-mul_tiles single-acquire pattern is not a perf win on this kernel and the explicit 3-acquire form is preferable.
